sermon.title: Jesus Returned Preaching The Gospel 04/28/2019
sermon.series: Why Jesus Is Important to All Mankind
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the fifth step of the Father’s business: Jesus returned preaching the gospel of repentance. Religious people hated Him without a cause. He distinguishes crime from sin, teaches that God calls us to hate evil, describes his own censored ads on Bible morality, and closes on God’s promise to pour out His Spirit on all flesh.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics, legal claims and media reach figures are kept as spoken and were not checked.
